import json, os, pathlib, sys, tempfile
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/Users/lanxingcan/Workspace/zstdoxize')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import check_reference_admission_v3 as m
attempts=[]
def no_process(event,args):
    if event in ('subprocess.Popen','os.system','os.fork','os.posix_spawn','os.exec','os.spawn'):
        attempts.append(event)
        raise RuntimeError('child creation forbidden')
sys.addaudithook(no_process)
files=m.projection()
m.verify(files)
controls=[]
def rejects(label,operation):
    try:operation()
    except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError):controls.append(label)
    else:raise ValueError('accepted '+label)
base=[14,18,19,8,4,0,3]
for label,changes,expected in [
 ('chain-max',{},'success'),('chain-too-wide',{1:19},'resource'),
 ('chain-too-deep',{3:9},'resource'),('row-unused-chain',{0:15,1:30,3:30},'success'),
 ('row-max',{0:21},'success'),('window-resource',{0:22},'resource'),
 ('hash-resource',{2:20},'resource'),('unsupported-before-resource',{0:31,1:30,2:30,3:30,6:4},'unsupported'),
 ('fast-unused-chain',{0:20,1:30,2:18,3:30,6:1},'success'),
 ('fast-window',{0:21,2:18,6:1},'resource'),('double-chain',{0:21,1:19,2:18,6:2},'resource')]:
    v=base.copy()
    for i,n in changes.items():v[i]=n
    m.require(m.classify(v)==expected,label)
    controls.append(label)
for index,(low,high) in enumerate([(10,31),(6,30),(6,30),(1,30),(3,7),(0,131072),(1,9)]):
    for value in (low-1,high+1,True,1.0,'1'):
        v=base.copy();v[index]=value
        rejects('scalar-'+str(index)+'-'+repr(value),lambda:m.classify(v))
for v in ([],base[:-1],base+[0],tuple(base),None):
    rejects('tuple-'+repr(v),lambda:m.classify(v))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='zstdoxide-v3-control-') as name:
    dest=pathlib.Path(name)
    (dest/'README.md').write_text('Test documentation\n')
    for n,b in files.items():(dest/n).write_bytes(b)
    m.verify(files,dest)
    for n in files:
        p=dest/n;p.write_bytes(files[n]+b'\n')
        rejects('changed-'+n,lambda:m.verify(files,dest));p.write_bytes(files[n])
    p=dest/'extra';p.touch();rejects('extra-file',lambda:m.verify(files,dest));p.unlink()
    p=dest/'fuzz.tsv';p.unlink();p.symlink_to(m.DESTINATION/'fuzz.tsv')
    rejects('linked-tsv',lambda:m.verify(files,dest));p.unlink();p.write_bytes(files['fuzz.tsv'])
    p=dest/'README.md';p.unlink();p.symlink_to(m.DESTINATION/'README.md')
    rejects('linked-readme',lambda:m.verify(files,dest))
    link=dest/'linked-directory';link.symlink_to(m.DESTINATION)
    rejects('linked-directory',lambda:m.verify(files,link))
m.require(not attempts,'no children')
print(json.dumps({'optimized':not __debug__,'projection_sha256':{n:m.sha(b) for n,b in files.items()},'controls':controls,'child_attempts':len(attempts)},sort_keys=True,indent=2))
